$comment: Combat (ruleset v0; spec S2 sections 5 and 6, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). melee.engagedSpeedPermille: a soldier with an enemy in reach moves at this share of its speed. volley: hits land on target soldiers within impactRadiusMm of the aim point; up to closeRangePermille of range a volley hits at its near chance. regimentTargeting is S2's working default until the regiment AI (M7): attackers turn on an enemy regiment within attackerEngageMm, defenders leave their ground for one within defenderEngageMm, ranged regiments shoot when a target is in range and fall back rangedFallbackMm when enemy melee comes within rangedFallbackTriggerMm.
